root_cause: The overlay element has data-micromodal-close, causing clicks inside the dialog (including Space-triggered click on the checkbox) to bubble up and close the modal.
repair_strategy: Remove the close trigger from the overlay so that only the close button and Done button close the modal. This prevents the checkbox click from closing the dialog while preserving keyboard accessibility.
expected_accessibility_effect: The dialog remains open when toggling checkboxes via Space, allowing keyboard users to change preferences without losing context. Focus stays on the checkbox, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: Clicking the overlay backdrop no longer closes the modal, which may be a UX change but is not covered by tests.
verification_requirements: Run the journey to confirm Space toggles weekly checkbox and dialog stays open.
Verify Done button and close button still close the dialog.
Check that form data includes 'weekly' after Space press.
